tool_input.command: rtk read -n src/users.js && echo "---" && rtk ls -la && rtk git log --oneline | head -5
tool_input.description: Show src/users.js with line numbers and repo state

result: I found three defects in `src/users.js`. I read the file but did not run it, so these come from reading the code. I made no changes. **1. `escapeHtml` does not escape all occurrences (lines 18–20). Security, high severity.** `String.prototype.replace` with a string pattern replaces only the first match. A name such as `<` becomes `<` tag. Any `<` or `>` after the first one passes through, and `&` is escaped only once. *Fix:* use global regular expressions and keep `&` first: ```js return String(text) .replace(/&/g, '&') .replace(//g, '>') .replace(/"/g, '"') .replace(/'/g, '''); ``` The quote escapes are not needed for the current text-content use in `userRow`. They make the helper safe if its output is ever placed inside an attribute. **2. `paginate` skips the first page (line 5). Correctness, high severity.** The doc comment says `page` is 1-based, but `start = page * size` treats it as 0-based. With `size = 10`, page 1 returns items 10–19 and items 0–9 are never shown. Page 0 returns the first page, which contradicts the comment. *Fix:* `const start = (page - 1) * size;`. If page 0 can reach this function, validate `page >= 1` and throw or clamp. **3. `isAdult` ignores month and day (lines 11–12). Correctness, medium severity.** It subtracts only the birth year, so someone born on 31 December 2008 counts as 18 on 1 January 2026, when they are 17. It is also wrong for anyone whose birthday has not yet occurred this year. *Fix:* subtract one year if the birthday has not yet occurred on `today`: ```js let age = today.getFullYear() - birthDate.getFullYear(); const beforeBirthday = today.getMonth() < birthDate.getMonth() || (today.getMonth() === birthDate.getMonth() && today.getDate() < birthDate.getDate()); if (beforeBirthday) age -= 1; return age >= 18; ``` `userRow` itself is fine as long as `escapeHtml` is fixed. `user.name` is escaped, and `isAdmin` is a boolean with no user-controlled text.
